title: The Potion That Made Everything Taste of Fish

collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — HUMOR AND ABSURDITY (HUM-01 to HUM-50, draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Slapstick, silly noises, puns, pranks with permission, ridiculous coincidences, a little funny magic and animals being absurd. Nobody is the butt of the joke: everyone keeps their dignity, and the comedy needs no victim.
Written in the style of the owner's own events. Edit anything and send it back; nothing ships until you approve.

collection.description: A villager tests a new drink and now everything tastes of fish: make the best of it, or ask a friend to try it too.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (subject) has been working on a drink to make bitter medicine taste sweet, and has tested it on (subject.him/her)self, as (subject.he/she) always does. (subject.He/she) feels perfectly well. The only thing is that everything now tastes of fish. Water: fish. Mango: fish. A plain piece of baked taro: very definitely fish.

o2.name: Outcome B
o2.text: (friend) refuses absolutely. So does everyone else, except (fisher), an old fisher, who says that everything already tastes of fish, drinks a sip, and reports no change at all. The scientists are still arguing about whether this counts as a result.

o1__fx.name: Outcome A
o1__fx.text: (subject) decides to make it useful. (subject.He/she) tastes all the foods (subject.he/she) has never liked. The bitter greens taste of fish. Not better, exactly, but different. (subject.He/she) spends the afternoon tasting the whole kitchen and taking careful notes. By evening it has worn off, and the first bite of a mango tastes like a mango again. (subject) nearly cries with joy.
